label: E2E-INSPIRED fine-tuning of local SAEs; NOT an exact reproduction of Braun et al. 2024 (arXiv:2405.12241)

budget.local_batch: 64+64 GoT-A rows + 128 OWT train rows (identical to Method A)
budget.e2e_batch: 8 OWT train sequences (128 tokens) + full statements of the 128 GoT-A rows

losses.KL: mean over spliced (non-BOS) positions of KL(p_orig || p_spliced), GPT-2 frozen
losses.DS: mean over blocks.7..11.hook_resid_pre of sum||a_spliced-a||^2 / sum||a-mean(a)||^2

alpha_beta_rule: per base SAE: alpha = median(local recon)/median(KL), beta = median(local recon)/median(DS) over 20 TRAIN batches at step 0 (values in alpha_beta.json)

matrix.new: B x 9, C x 9 (relu/topk/jumprelu x seeds 42/1042/2042)
matrix.repro_check: alpha=beta=0 TopK seed 42 must be bit-identical to Method A TopK seed 42; stop otherwise

evaluation: validation only (scripts/shared/layer6_faithfulness_eval.py): OWT EV/MSE/cosine/dead, L0 on OWT, GoT and RepE separately, downstream NMSE layers 7-11, OWT splice delta CE + KL, GoT statement KL + cities preference, RepE final KL + persona-shift cosine (splicing, not steering), GoT B-group logistic/MLP/mass-mean gaps, decodability diagnostic, RepE logistic/mass-mean gaps + direction fidelity. No validation/test data in training or selection; no checkpoint selection.

criteria.unit: per architecture, for B and C separately, paired by seed vs Method A; "consistent" = better on all 3 seeds AND mean paired difference > 2 x its sd
criteria.P1: OWT validation splice KL lower than Method A (consistent)
criteria.P2: GoT validation statement KL lower than Method A (consistent)
criteria.H_truth: GoT geographic B-MLP gap lower than Method A (consistent)
guards: OWT-validation L0 within +-5 % of the base SAE (every seed)
OWT validation EV >= Method A - 0.02 (every seed)
GoT geographic B-logistic gap <= Method A + 0.02 (mean)
criteria.behavioural_success: P1 AND P2 AND all guards
criteria.C_vs_B: descriptive (downstream NMSE expected lower for C)

longer_budget_rule.note: flag only; a longer run is a separate experiment needing approval; never run automatically
longer_budget_rule.flag_if: for an architecture x method: behavioural_success is NOT met AND in >= 2 of 3 seeds the TRAIN monitor KL (fixed 8 OWT train sequences, every 50 steps) is (i) >= 5 % below its step-0 value at step 500 and (ii) still falling: KL(500) <= 0.98 * KL(400)
